units.source_text: 这一夜，我依然难以成眠。

en.t: That night, I still found it hard to sleep.

units.source_text: 我藐视老师，我要嘲笑他的伪善。

en.t: I despised my teacher, and I wanted to laugh at his hypocrisy.

units.source_text: 但是，我渐渐露出了一种悔恨

en.t: But little by little, a kind of regret began to show in me,

units.source_text: 自己不能总是保持着这样兴奋的情绪。

en.t: regret that I could not always maintain such an excited state of mind.

units.source_text: 我对老师的伪善表示的轻蔑，在奇妙的状况下，

en.t: The contempt I had shown for my teacher's hypocrisy, under strange circumstances,

units.source_text: 与我的意志薄弱结合在一起，

en.t: combined with my own weakness of will,

units.source_text: 我终于明白了他是个不足取的人，

en.t: until I finally understood that he was a person of little worth,

units.source_text: 我甚至想到哪怕向他道歉也不算是我的失败。

en.t: and I even thought that apologizing to him would not count as my defeat.

units.source_text: 我的这种心绪一度爬上了顶峰，

en.t: This state of mind of mine once climbed to its peak,

units.source_text: 尔后又沿着陡坡快步跑了下来。

en.t: and then hurried back down along a steep slope.
